title: Remove platform-dependent report directory warnings
platforms: Linux and Windows Rust conditional compilation
changes: Replace mutable link flags with immutable bindings and Windows-only shadowing in recent-event and issue-report output checks, removing Linux unused_mut warnings while retaining symlink, reparse-point and non-directory rejection.
validation: Compiled the exact edited metadata-check blocks with rustc --emit=metadata -Dwarnings for x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu and x86_64-pc-windows-gnu; both passed without diagnostics.
Compared retained preimages and confirmed all source bytes outside the two binding blocks are unchanged.
limitations: This was a compiler-only check of the edited blocks, not a full application/Docker build or a new report/runtime test. Existing report behavior acceptance was not rerun.
